findings.title: No active database - file-based storage only
findings.details: System uses JSON files instead of SQL, eliminating SQL injection risk

findings.title: Comprehensive Zod validation
findings.details: All inputs validated against schemas before processing

findings.title: Race conditions in file-based storage
findings.details: Multiple processes writing to data/*.json simultaneously not guaranteed atomic
findings.recommendation: Implement file locking or migrate to Supabase

findings.title: 3-layer XSS protection
findings.details: Zod validation, JSON encoding, and CSP headers

findings.title: Extensive test coverage
findings.details: 844 lines of XSS tests covering 50+ attack vectors

findings.title: Error logs may contain user input
findings.details: Logs could be rendered in HTML dashboards without escaping
findings.recommendation: Escape error logs in rendered contexts

findings.title: CSRF protection implemented
findings.details: Double-submit cookie pattern with secure flags

findings.title: CSRF middleware not applied to endpoints
findings.details: POST /api/kanban, PUT, DELETE bypass validateCsrfMiddleware
findings.recommendation: Apply validateCsrfMiddleware to all POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH routes

findings.title: CSRF token cookie never set
findings.details: setCsrfTokenCookie() exists but is never called in routes

findings.title: No SameSite attribute on JWT cookies
findings.details: JWT authentication cookies lack SameSite=strict protection
findings.recommendation: Add sameSite: 'strict' to JWT cookie settings

findings.title: JWT-based authentication
findings.details: Proper token generation with expiration and validation

findings.title: Role-based authorization
findings.details: Comprehensive permission checking with whitelist validation

findings.title: Refresh token type not validated
findings.details: Refresh tokens lack type check in verifyToken()

findings.title: No token revocation mechanism
findings.details: Compromised tokens remain valid until natural expiration

findings.title: Safe error messages in production
findings.details: Generic messages returned to clients, details logged server-side

findings.title: Sensitive data not logged
findings.details: Query parameters and auth tokens explicitly excluded from logs

findings.title: .env files not in .gitignore
findings.details: JWT_SECRET and other secrets could be committed to git

findings.title: Data files not excluded from git
findings.details: dashboard/data/*.json may be committed (alerts, meetings, conductor logs)

findings.title: Git history may contain secrets
findings.details: Previous commits may have exposed .env files
findings.recommendation: Audit git history with git-secrets or similar

findings.title: Secure token generation
findings.details: Uses crypto.randomBytes for CSRF tokens (256-bit entropy)

findings.title: Timing-safe comparison
findings.details: Uses crypto.timingSafeEqual to prevent timing attacks

findings.title: Secure cookie flags
findings.details: httpOnly, secure (HTTPS), sameSite=strict flags set

findings.title: JWT_SECRET length not validated
findings.details: No check that secret is >= 32 bytes on startup

findings.title: No key rotation mechanism
findings.details: Compromised keys affect all tokens until natural expiration
findings.recommendation: Document and implement secret rotation procedures

findings.title: Strict auth endpoint limits
findings.details: Auth endpoints limited to 5 requests/minute (brute force protection)

findings.title: IP-based limiting
findings.details: Respects X-Forwarded-For and x-real-ip headers

findings.title: Standard rate limit headers
findings.details: X-RateLimit-*, Retry-After headers present

findings.title: In-memory store not distributed
findings.details: Each PM2 process has separate rate limit state
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Redis for distributed consistency

findings.title: Bypassable via IP spoofing
findings.details: Shared proxy/VPN can bypass per-IP limits
findings.recommendation: Monitor for abuse patterns; consider user-based limiting

critical_issues.title: CSRF protection not enforced on state-changing endpoints
critical_issues.description: validateCsrfMiddleware is implemented but never applied to POST/PUT/DELETE endpoints
critical_issues.impact: Attacker can submit forms from malicious sites to perform unauthorized actions
critical_issues.remediation: Apply validateCsrfMiddleware to all POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH routes

critical_issues.title: Environment secrets not excluded from version control
critical_issues.description: .env* files not in .gitignore; JWT_SECRET and other secrets could be committed
critical_issues.impact: Production credentials exposed in public/shared git repository
critical_issues.remediation: Add .env* to .gitignore, audit history, rotate all secrets

critical_issues.title: Refresh token type not validated
critical_issues.description: Refresh tokens include type: 'refresh' but verifyToken() doesn't validate it
critical_issues.impact: Refresh tokens can be used as access tokens
critical_issues.remediation: Add type validation in verifyToken() function

important_issues.title: Data files not excluded from git
important_issues.description: dashboard/data/ contains application state (alerts, meetings, tasks)

important_issues.title: In-memory rate limiting not distributed
important_issues.description: Rate limits reset per-process; bypassable in cluster mode

important_issues.title: No token revocation mechanism
important_issues.description: Compromised tokens remain valid until expiration

phase_1_critical: Audit git history for exposed secrets
Apply CSRF middleware to all state-changing endpoints
Validate refresh token type in verifyToken()

strengths: Strong authentication with JWT and role-based access
weaknesses: CSRF protection not enforced on endpoints
Secrets not excluded from git repository
